articles.title: Undo a WooCommerce bulk price edit from the pre-change CSV
articles.meta_description: WooCommerce bulk edit writes prices on Update and has no undo. Restore them from a dated CSV. A 20% cut is not fixed by raising 20%.
articles.h1: Undo a WooCommerce bulk price edit from the pre-change CSV

articles.title: Restore WooCommerce sale prices a CSV import overwrote
articles.meta_description: A mapped Sale price column overwrites the stored sale. Restore it from the pre-import export, and set every other column to Do not import.
articles.h1: Restore WooCommerce sale prices a CSV import overwrote

articles.title: An imported WooCommerce sale is saved but the shop shows full price
articles.meta_description: If the variation shows the sale and the shop shows the regular price, do not import again. Update one variable product, then recheck the shop.
articles.h1: An imported WooCommerce sale is saved but the shop shows full price
articles.failure_family: stored sale hidden by a stale variable-product range

articles.title: Stop staff and AI tools from changing WooCommerce prices
articles.meta_description: WooCommerce has no price-only role. Remove product-edit access and revoke write keys. An opt-in grant is a bounded job, not a lock on every account.
articles.h1: Stop staff and AI tools from changing WooCommerce prices

articles.title: Keep a WooCommerce price history with a dated CSV
articles.meta_description: WooCommerce has no catalog price log. Export ID, SKU, and prices before each bulk change. A history plugin only records what happens after you install it.
articles.h1: Keep a WooCommerce price history with a dated CSV
